nodes.name: Donald J. Trump
nodes.desc: 45th and 47th President. Central hub connecting all five network clusters through business interests, political appointments, and foreign policy decisions that benefit financial allies.

nodes.name: Jared Kushner
nodes.desc: Trump son-in-law. Founded Affinity Partners the day after leaving the White House. Received $2B from Saudi PIF. Collected $157M in management fees from foreign clients while distributing zero returns to investors.

nodes.name: Saudi Public Investment Fund
nodes.desc: Saudi Arabian sovereign wealth fund controlled by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. Invested $2B in Kushner's Affinity Partners despite internal screening panel rating Kushner's operations unsatisfactory.

nodes.name: Affinity Partners
nodes.desc: Kushner's private equity firm founded January 2021. Received $2B from Saudi PIF and Gulf sovereign wealth funds. Collected $157M in fees, $87M from Saudi Arabia alone, with zero returns to investors.

nodes.name: TikTok / ByteDance
nodes.desc: Chinese social media giant. Trump-era $10B+ fee arrangement raised national security questions about beneficial ownership and data access.

nodes.name: Reliance Industries
nodes.desc: Indian conglomerate and world's largest single buyer of Russian crude in 2024-2025. Also Russia's largest provider of oil-refining catalysts. Financing America First Refining in Brownsville, Texas.

nodes.name: Peter Thiel
nodes.desc: PayPal co-founder and Palantir co-founder. Bankrolled Trump's rise and helped install JD Vance. Back pumping millions into Republican PACs for 2026 midterms. Has stated freedom and democracy are not compatible.

nodes.name: J.D. Vance
nodes.desc: Vice President. Former Thiel-backed Senate candidate. Connected to Thiel network and crypto deregulation policy architecture.

nodes.name: David Sacks
nodes.desc: Trump-appointed AI and crypto policy czar. PayPal Mafia member. Retains 7.8% stake in BitGo while architecting federal crypto deregulatory framework that weakens OFAC enforcement.

nodes.name: Binance / CZ
nodes.desc: World's largest crypto exchange. Pleaded guilty to BSA violations and sanctions evasion. Fined $4.3B. Trump business partner now seeking regulatory rehabilitation under his administration.

nodes.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
nodes.desc: SPAC-listed company with opaque ownership and financing. Allegations of Russian money flows into the company.

nodes.name: UAE / Abu Dhabi
nodes.desc: Key Gulf hub for Russian oligarch capital flight, sanctions-busting real estate, and Trump/Kushner deal-making. Home of MGX and the Aqua 1 Foundation shell entity.

nodes.name: Russia / Kremlin
nodes.desc: Subject of sweeping OFAC sanctions since 2014, expanded 2022. Primary beneficiary of weakened US enforcement posture under Trump-world-aligned actors and crypto rails.

nodes.name: Trump Organization
nodes.desc: Trump family business entity. Active foreign deals in Gulf, India, and Eastern Europe. Continued operations during presidential terms create financial-foreign policy entanglement.

nodes.name: Alaska LNG Project
nodes.desc: Proposed LNG megaproject in Alaska. Gentry Beach signed agreement with Russia's Novatek to develop it using Russian technology. Beach said it is known about at the highest levels in Washington and Moscow.

nodes.name: OFAC / Treasury
nodes.desc: Office of Foreign Assets Control — US sanctions enforcement arm. Enforcement posture significantly weakened under Trump-era appointments and deregulatory pressure.

nodes.name: Tether / USDT
nodes.desc: Dominant stablecoin used extensively for sanctions evasion by Russian, Iranian, and Venezuelan actors. Opaque reserves. Commerce Secretary Lutnick's firm Cantor Fitzgerald manages $80B in Tether reserves.

nodes.name: Paul Manafort
nodes.desc: Former Trump campaign chairman. Convicted of money laundering and failing to register as a foreign agent. Connected to Russian and Ukrainian oligarch financial flows.

nodes.name: China / CCP
nodes.desc: Operating CIPS parallel payment system increasingly used to route sanctioned-state transactions outside US financial reach. Source of suspect funding via Aqua 1 Foundation.

nodes.name: FTX / Sam Bankman-Fried
nodes.desc: Collapsed crypto exchange. Largest political donor in 2022 cycle. Offshore Bahamas structure used for commingled political and business funds.

nodes.name: Paul Atkins
nodes.desc: SEC Chair appointed by Trump. Previously co-chaired Token Alliance, a crypto lobbying group, and held $6M in crypto assets. Oversaw the reclassification of 16 major cryptocurrencies as digital commodities, ending the crypto enforcement era.

nodes.name: Fairshake PAC
nodes.desc: Crypto industry's political action committee bankrolled by Coinbase, Ripple, and Andreessen Horowitz. $193M cash on hand for 2026 midterms. Single largest outside spender in the 2024 cycle at $290M. Spent $271M total.

nodes.name: Steve Witkoff
nodes.desc: Real estate developer with no diplomatic experience appointed by Trump as Russia-Ukraine peace envoy. Maintained financial partnership with sanctioned billionaire Len Blavatnik. Leaked transcript showed him coaching a Putin aide.

nodes.name: Gentry Beach
nodes.desc: College friend of Donald Trump Jr. and former deputy finance chairman of Trump inauguration. Signed agreement with Russia's Novatek for Alaska gas project using Russian technology. Previously involved in attempt to relaunch Nord Stream 2.

nodes.name: Michael Flynn
nodes.desc: Former National Security Advisor who admitted to secretly working for a foreign government. Hired by Republika Srpska at $100,000/month to lobby for Putin ally Milorad Dodik.

nodes.name: Rudy Giuliani
nodes.desc: Former NYC mayor and Trump personal attorney. Part of the MAGA Balkans lobbying campaign. Visited Banja Luka with Make Srpska Great Again branding.

nodes.name: Milorad Dodik
nodes.desc: Leader of Republika Srpska and Putin's closest Balkan ally. Previously US-sanctioned. Sanctions lifted by Trump administration in October 2025 following MAGA lobbying campaign.

nodes.name: Len Blavatnik
nodes.desc: Ukrainian-sanctioned billionaire with ties to Russia. Maintained financial partnership with Steve Witkoff while Witkoff served as Russia-Ukraine peace envoy.

nodes.name: Novatek
nodes.desc: One of Russia's largest energy producers. No other Russian company is closer to the Kremlin. Signed Alaska gas deal with Gentry Beach. Leads consortia to build LNG megaprojects to restore Russia's global energy leverage.

nodes.name: Pam Bondi
nodes.desc: Attorney General. On her first day, disbanded the DOJ Kleptocracy Team that tracked Russian oligarchs' stolen money. Paused FCPA enforcement. Gutted FARA enforcement and disbanded the Foreign Influence Task Force.

nodes.name: DOJ Kleptocracy Team
nodes.desc: Department of Justice unit that tracked and recovered Russian oligarchs' stolen money. Disbanded by AG Bondi on her first day in office.

nodes.name: Palantir
nodes.desc: AI defense contractor co-founded by Thiel. Stock valuation exceeds $300B. Signed strategic partnership with Israeli Defence Ministry. Its AI platform is being used in the Iran war its founders called for.

nodes.name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
nodes.desc: Venture firm that gave $70M to Fairshake PAC. Partners gave millions directly to Trump. Built a real-time war dashboard tracking strikes on Iran.

nodes.name: Coinbase
nodes.desc: Major US crypto exchange. Core funder of Fairshake PAC alongside Ripple and a16z. Enforcement case dismissed by SEC under Atkins.

nodes.name: World Liberty Financial
nodes.desc: Trump family crypto venture. Trump family owns 60% and receives 75% of token sale proceeds. Received $100M from the unregistered Aqua 1 Foundation shell entity tied to the UAE.

nodes.name: Aqua 1 Foundation
nodes.desc: Phantom UAE-based foundation with no address, no registration, and a founder (Dave Lee) who may not exist. Wired $100M to Trump's World Liberty Financial. Website registered 12 days after Trump's UAE visit.

nodes.name: Howard Lutnick
nodes.desc: Commerce Secretary and former Cantor Fitzgerald CEO. Cantor Fitzgerald manages $80B in Tether reserves. Known associate of Jeffrey Epstein.

nodes.name: Viktor Orban
nodes.desc: Hungarian PM whose government systematically paid American conservative influencers and think tanks. Heritage Foundation president called his illiberal state the model for conservative statecraft.

nodes.name: Heritage Foundation
nodes.desc: Conservative think tank that authored Project 2025. Signed cooperation agreement with Hungary's Danube Institute in 2022. President Kevin Roberts received a Hungarian state award.

nodes.name: Mukesh Ambani
nodes.desc: Chairman of Reliance Industries and richest man in Asia. Special guest at Trump's inauguration. Financing America First Refining in Texas while Reliance is the world's largest buyer of Russian crude.

nodes.name: America First Refining
nodes.desc: America's first new oil refinery in 50 years, located in Brownsville, Texas. Financed by Reliance Industries. VP is Nick Ayers, former Trump assistant. Financial advisor is Cantor Fitzgerald (Lutnick's firm).

nodes.name: Ric Grenell
nodes.desc: Former acting DNI and Kennedy Center director. Received Order of the Serbian Flag (same decoration given to Russian FM Lavrov). Part of MAGA Balkans lobbying campaign. Business deals with pro-Kremlin Balkan politicians.

nodes.name: SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission)
nodes.desc: Federal investor protection agency. Under Atkins, issued joint interpretation reclassifying crypto as commodities. Dismissed crypto cases at 33% rate vs 4% for other cases.

nodes.name: Elliott Management
nodes.desc: US hedge fund reportedly considering investing in Russia's TurkStream gas pipeline. May be investing pension fund capital in strategic Russian energy assets.

nodes.name: Rod Blagojevich
nodes.desc: Former Illinois governor pardoned by Trump. Registered under FARA to lobby for Republika Srpska alongside Flynn and Giuliani.

nodes.name: Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan
nodes.desc: UAE national security advisor and brother of UAE president. Owns 49% stake in World Liberty Financial. Chairs MGX, which used WLF's USD1 stablecoin to settle a $2B investment in Binance. Oversaw $500M investment that bought 500,000 advanced US AI chips.

nodes.name: MGX
nodes.desc: Abu Dhabi state-owned investment firm chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon. Holds 15% stake in TikTok US entity. Used World Liberty Financial's USD1 stablecoin to settle $2B Binance investment.

nodes.name: Oracle / Larry Ellison
nodes.desc: Co-founded by Larry Ellison, longtime Trump ally. Holds 15% stake in TikTok US entity. Part of consortium that paid $10B fee to Trump administration for the TikTok deal.

nodes.name: Silver Lake
nodes.desc: Tech-focused private equity firm with ties to China and the Middle East. Holds 15% stake in TikTok US entity alongside Oracle and MGX.

nodes.name: G42
nodes.desc: Abu Dhabi AI company controlled by Sheikh Tahnoon. Received 100,000 advanced US AI chips that Biden had blocked on national security grounds due to G42 CEO's links to Chinese companies.

nodes.name: Gazprom
nodes.desc: Russia's state-owned gas monopoly. Exports declined 42% since pre-invasion levels. Pipeline gas leverage over Europe weakened after Ukraine terminated transit in late 2024.

nodes.name: Arctic LNG-2
nodes.desc: Novatek's multi-billion dollar LNG megaproject in Russia's Arctic. Biden administration tried to kill it with sanctions. Trump administration potentially willing to lift sanctions as part of Ukraine deal.

nodes.name: TotalEnergies
nodes.desc: French energy company that held 19.4% stake in Novatek. Declared force majeure on Arctic LNG-2 in early 2024, withdrawing from the project due to sanctions.

nodes.name: Elon Musk / DOGE
nodes.desc: Head of Department of Government Efficiency. DOGE operatives gained access to Treasury payment systems, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare data. Part of PayPal Mafia with Thiel and Sacks.

nodes.name: Kirill Dmitriev
nodes.desc: Russian envoy who co-authored the 28-point peace plan with Witkoff. The plan was based on a Russian-authored paper and read like a list of Kremlin demands.

nodes.name: Steve Feinberg
nodes.desc: Deputy Secretary of Defense and co-founder of Cerberus Capital Management. Listed assets worth at least $2B. Maintains ongoing financial relationship with Cerberus while overseeing defense policy.

nodes.name: Cerberus Capital Management
nodes.desc: Private equity firm co-founded by Steve Feinberg. Feinberg maintains financial ties with Cerberus while serving as Deputy Defense Secretary.

nodes.name: Corporate Transparency Act (CTA)
nodes.desc: Legislation creating a federal registry of beneficial owners of US companies. Currently blocked by courts. Project 2025 and Trump allies seek to kill it permanently.

nodes.name: Task Force KleptoCapture
nodes.desc: DOJ task force that restrained nearly $700M in Russian oligarch assets and charged 70+ individuals. Shut down by AG Bondi on her first day in office.

nodes.name: Changpeng Zhao (CZ)
nodes.desc: Founder of Binance who pleaded guilty to enabling money laundering. Pardoned by Trump after Sheikh Tahnoon's MGX invested $2B in Binance using Trump's crypto token.

nodes.name: Delyan Peevski
nodes.desc: Bulgarian oligarch designated under the Global Magnitsky Act by US Treasury. Allegedly threatened and smeared European prosecutors investigating corruption.

nodes.name: CFPB
nodes.desc: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. Enforcement division slashed from 248 to 50 employees. Consumer complaints surged 89%. Senate estimated attacks on CFPB cost Americans $19B.

nodes.name: Ripple
nodes.desc: Crypto company and core funder of Fairshake PAC alongside Coinbase and a16z. SEC enforcement case dismissed under Atkins.

nodes.name: AfriForum
nodes.desc: Afrikaner-rights group aligned with Elon Musk. Lobbied the Trump administration since 2018 to target South Africa over land reform. Influenced the February 2025 executive order freezing bilateral aid.

nodes.name: Cyril Ramaphosa
nodes.desc: South African President and 2025 G20 host. Targeted by Trump executive order freezing bilateral aid over land reform law, partly due to AfriForum-Musk lobbying.

nodes.name: Marco Rubio
nodes.desc: Secretary of State. Boycotted first G20 foreign ministerial meeting in South Africa.

nodes.name: Scott Bessent
nodes.desc: Treasury Secretary. Refused to attend G20 finance ministers meeting in Cape Town.

nodes.name: CREW
nodes.desc: Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington. Documented over 3,700 conflicts of interest in the first Trump administration.

nodes.name: Sarah Chayes
nodes.desc: Anti-corruption expert and author of On Corruption in America, documenting how Washington is run by a system of self-dealing elites straddling public and private sectors.

nodes.name: Transparency International
nodes.desc: Berlin-based anticorruption organization. Dropped America to score of 64/100 on 2026 CPI -- lowest ever, behind Lithuania, Barbados, and Uruguay.

nodes.name: Qorvis
nodes.desc: Communications firm paid $1.2M by Novatek in 2014-17 for lobbying. Part of the Russian LNG lobby ecosystem in Washington.

nodes.name: Denis Solovyov
nodes.desc: Senior Novatek executive dispatched to Washington in December 2024 to engage US lobbyists seeking sanctions relief for Arctic LNG-2.

nodes.name: Steve Bannon
nodes.desc: Former Trump strategist. Hired by Hungarian state-funded foundation for $60,000 in 2018 alongside Milo Yiannopoulos as part of Orban's influence operation to buy American conservatives.

nodes.name: Danube Institute
nodes.desc: Budapest-based conservative think tank funded by Hungarian government. Primary tool for networking in the US. Signed cooperation agreement with Heritage Foundation in 2022.

nodes.name: Spencer Chretien
nodes.desc: Co-director of Project 2025. Heavily involved in building ties between Heritage Foundation and Hungary. Featured in leaked training videos instructing appointees.

nodes.name: Jeffrey Epstein
nodes.desc: Late convicted sex offender and financier whose files revealed extensive network with MAGA figures. Cooperated with Bannon in Eastern Europe. Linked to Musk, Thiel, and Trump orbit.

nodes.name: Craft Ventures
nodes.desc: David Sacks's venture firm. Retained 708 tech investments including 449 AI companies and 20 crypto firms in sectors where Sacks directly shapes federal policy. Holds 7.8% stake in BitGo.

nodes.name: BitGo
nodes.desc: Crypto custody firm in which Sacks's Craft Ventures holds 7.8% stake valued at $130M+. Offers stablecoin-as-a-service. Celebrated GENIUS Act that Sacks backed. Filed for IPO.

nodes.name: GENIUS Act
nodes.desc: First federal regulatory framework for stablecoins. Backed by David Sacks while his firm held 7.8% in BitGo, which directly benefits. BitGo called it a defining moment.

nodes.name: Miroslav Lajcak
nodes.desc: Former Slovak national security adviser who resigned after Epstein files showed numerous exchanges with the financier. Also in contact with Bannon.

nodes.name: Robert Fico
nodes.desc: Slovak PM with authoritarian-leaning tendencies. Recommended by Lajcak as participant in Bannon's European far-right alliance project. Lajcak told Bannon Fico would like to play Steve's game.

nodes.name: Nvidia
nodes.desc: Leading AI chip maker. CEO Jensen Huang met Sacks in Oval Office. Sacks brokered sale of 500,000 AI chips to UAE while holding investments in AI sector.

nodes.name: Peter Mandelson
nodes.desc: UK ambassador to the US. Scandal-prone former Labour power broker who sat on the board of a Russian military-industrial group. UK betting he can work with Trump administration.

nodes.name: Bashar al-Assad
nodes.desc: Former Syrian dictator whose family ran Syria as a kleptocracy for five decades. Net worth $1-2B via systematic theft. Fled to Moscow in December 2024 after rebel victory.

nodes.name: Gautam Adani
nodes.desc: Indian billionaire and coal magnate. Indicted by US DOJ for alleged $265M bribery scheme. Close relationship with PM Modi. Stocks tumbled 20% on indictment.

nodes.name: Narendra Modi
nodes.desc: Indian PM and BJP leader with Hindu-nationalist agenda. Close ties to Adani. Relationship with US likely to deepen under Trump, complicating anti-corruption enforcement.

nodes.name: Calin Georgescu
nodes.desc: Romanian ultranationalist independent who surged to lead in presidential polls via TikTok campaign. NATO-skeptical, Russia-friendly rhetoric with MAGA vibes.

nodes.name: Leon Black
nodes.desc: Former Apollo Asset Management CEO. Paid Epstein $158-170M from 2012-2017, making him Epstein's largest known funder. Paid $62.5M to USVI for immunity from prosecution.

nodes.name: Leslie Wexner
nodes.desc: Victoria's Secret founder who granted Epstein full power of attorney over his fortune. Name appears 4,000+ times in Epstein files. Sat for six-hour deposition Feb 2026.

nodes.name: Deutsche Bank
nodes.desc: Maintained 40+ accounts for Epstein between 2013-2018. Processed hundreds of transactions including payments to alleged co-conspirators. 97 cash withdrawals totaling $800K+.

nodes.name: Todd Blanche
nodes.desc: Deputy AG who holds up to $485K in personal crypto investments while managing DOJ crypto enforcement. Announced no additional Epstein prosecutions. Defended redaction failures.

nodes.name: Brock Pierce
nodes.desc: Co-founded Tether with Giancarlo Devasini. Bannon ran Pierce's company. Part of the Bannon-Tether-Epstein nexus connecting crypto infrastructure to political influence.

nodes.name: Azerbaijan
nodes.desc: Post-Soviet petrostate that hosted COP29. Positioned to replace Russian gas transit through Ukraine to Central Europe. Another authoritarian energy dependency risk for the EU.

nodes.name: Nigel Farage / Reform UK
nodes.desc: Reform UK leader. Musk said he wanted to put $100M into Reform UK, calling it the UK's only hope. 25% of UK voters prefer Farage in polls. Right-wing populist linked to Trump orbit.

nodes.name: Nick Ayers
nodes.desc: Incoming VP of America First Refining. Former Assistant to the President in Trump's first term. Close to Ivanka and Kushner. Co-founder of pro-Trump nonprofit America First Policies.

nodes.name: Rumble
nodes.desc: Canadian-founded video platform serving as a key node in the MAGA media ecosystem. Hosts Truth Social's video infrastructure and serves as an alternative to YouTube for right-wing content creators.

nodes.name: Kristi Noem / DHS
nodes.desc: Secretary of Homeland Security. Overseeing expansion of ICE detention infrastructure fueled by private contractor corruption and questionable procurement practices.

nodes.name: Nord Stream 2
nodes.desc: Defunct Russia-to-Germany gas pipeline. Revival discussions under Trump signal willingness to reward Russian energy interests and undermine European energy security.

nodes.name: Raiffeisen Bank International
nodes.desc: Austrian bank maintaining significant operations in Russia despite Western sanctions. New York regulators have authority to investigate its dollar-clearing activities.

nodes.name: Marc Andreessen
nodes.desc: Co-founder of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Major crypto industry investor and political donor. Firm's portfolio companies have benefited from sanctions and enforcement rollbacks.

nodes.name: Securitize
nodes.desc: Tokenization platform tapped by World Liberty Financial to tokenize Trump hotel development in the Maldives. Backed by BlackRock.

nodes.name: Dar Global
nodes.desc: London-listed Saudi-backed luxury real estate developer partnering with Trump Organization on the tokenized Trump International Hotel Maldives project.

nodes.name: USD1 Stablecoin
nodes.desc: Stablecoin issued by World Liberty Financial, reaching $3.3B in circulation. Used by UAE's MGX to fund $2B Binance deal. Custodied by BitGo, in which David Sacks holds a stake via Craft Ventures.

nodes.name: $TRUMP Memecoin
nodes.desc: Presidential memecoin down 95.7% from all-time high of $73.43. Insiders control over 525M of 1B token supply. Multiple Mar-a-Lago dinners for top holders used to temporarily pump price.

nodes.name: Jessica Steinmann
nodes.desc: Former DOJ lawyer backed by Trump who won Texas congressional primary with over $750K in Fairshake PAC support. Part of crypto industry's capture of 2026 midterm elections.

nodes.name: Donald Trump Jr.
nodes.desc: President's eldest son. Co-founder of World Liberty Financial and American Bitcoin mining venture. College roommate Gentry Beach signed deal with Novatek for Arctic mineral extraction.

nodes.name: Eric Trump
nodes.desc: Executive VP of Trump Organization. Co-founder of World Liberty Financial. Signed $500M UAE stake deal four days before inauguration. Oversees American Bitcoin mining operation.

nodes.name: American Bitcoin
nodes.desc: Bitcoin mining operation overseen by Eric Trump. Absorbed mining operations from Hut 8. Part of the Trump family's four-pillar crypto empire.

nodes.name: Rep. Ro Khanna
nodes.desc: Democratic congressman. Set March 1 deadline for World Liberty Financial to produce documents on foreign investment relationships. WLFI refused, calling the request a 'baseless assault.'

nodes.name: North Korea / DPRK
nodes.desc: State-sponsored hackers steal hundreds of millions in cryptocurrency, laundered through A16z-linked platforms, funding nuclear weapons program. Primary beneficiary of crypto regulatory blind spots.

nodes.name: Cantor Fitzgerald
nodes.desc: Wall Street firm run by Howard Lutnick before he became Commerce Secretary. Handed to his sons upon his appointment. Has direct financial stake in Tether and Rumble, creating ongoing conflicts of interest.

nodes.name: Kash Patel
nodes.desc: Trump-appointed FBI Director. Former Rumble investor. Part of the Thiel-adjacent network placed throughout national security and law enforcement positions.

nodes.name: French Hill
nodes.desc: House Financial Services Committee Chairman. Received $400,000 from Fairshake PAC. Point man on crypto deregulation legislation including the CLARITY Act, which would permanently exempt major cryptocurrencies from SEC oversight.
